# Fixture: bbc_des_bayesn_biascor

Independent BayeSN W22 bias-correction simulation on the DES cadence.
`FITRES.TEXT.gz` contains the JAX-fitted table in deterministic gzip format.
The software versions, settings and complete regeneration commands are in
[the data fixture README](../bbc_des_bayesn_data/README.md).

HEAD/PHOT are used for fitting but are not bundled.
